summary: A run action takes Run (absolute command path and args, not executed in a shell; use /usr/bin/bash -c for shell features), optional EnvVars, WorkDir, Timeout (e.g. 30s, 5m, 1h) and If conditions; in afterUpdating, path conditions can restrict an action to changes under a file or directory.
questions: How do I write a run action in a lifecycle hook?
Why do shell variables not work in my hook command?
How do I set a timeout on a hook action?
How do I run a hook only when a file changed?
